invariants: category_id must be a valid auto-incremented primary key (exists in the database)
sku must be unique across all products
price_cents must be a non-negative integer
stock_qty must be a non-negative integer
low_active must be a boolean (default False)
reorder_threshold must be a non-negative integer if provided
category.name must be unique across all categories
stock_qty must be updated to a non-negative integer when restocking
the total stock value (price_cents * stock_qty) must not be negative for any product
category_id must be nullable in Product model if not enforced via foreign key constraints
products must belong to an existing category (category_id must exist in the database)
